claim: For every actual ordinary two-arm product p of degree D, T_p(n)<=0 at every n strictly after its LAST ordinary mode with 2n<=D; no E_n>=0 assumption.
review_result: Both reviewed the complete induction: rectangle base, deleted-rectangle crossing, first/last window-mode relationship, balanced new-source edges, monotone old source prefix, local-universal support, late/main/virtual interval payments, complementary mass contradiction and three integer boundaries. No gap found.
consequences: All correctly conditioned coupled-S tails in the reverse first half, equivalently forward second half, are nonrecovering; OLD nonnegative-head input then pays S.
For nonrectangular arm pairs, together with the existing first-half both-forward-nonincreasing theorem, every BOTH-nonincreasing proper-S tail is nonrecovering at every rank.
scope_limits: Generic kernels plus a written unbounded actual-arm induction, not an end-to-end Lean formalization.
Finite QA is distinct from and does not replace the unbounded proof.
No ordinary half-LC, general C, A2 or original coefficient-unimodality conclusion.
